Ultimately, the best outfit is the one that makes you feel like the best version of yourself. If a dress and high heels are your go‑to confidence boosters, own that choice and wear it proudly. And if you ever want to mix things up or explore new styles, feel free to experiment—confidence can be a fluid, evolving thing.
